title: Redesign Devotional App with Saffron/Gold Hindu Theme

requirements.text: Redesign the entire frontend visual theme to use a saffron (deep orange #FF6B00), gold (#FFD700), red (#C0392B), and warm yellow (#FFA500) devotional color palette. Replace the dark theme with a warm, light-to-rich devotional aesthetic inspired by Hindu temple decor — think marigold garlands, temple brass, and sacred fire. Apply consistent saffron/gold gradients to headers, cards, and section backgrounds. Use cream/off-white (#FFF8E7) as the base background.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages use the saffron/gold/red-yellow color palette consistently
No dark background remains on any page or component
Cards and containers use warm cream or gradient backgrounds
Header and BottomNav reflect the saffron/gold devotional theme
Text is clearly legible on all backgrounds with proper contrast

requirements.text: Redesign the Home page (frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx) with a grand devotional hero banner featuring an Om symbol, Sanskrit greeting text, and the current Panchang tithi displayed prominently. Include beautifully styled category cards for Mantras/Shlokas, Aarti, Puja Vidhi, and Bhajans with deity icons/emojis. Display the Daily Dharma Quote and a featured Shloka card in an ornate card style with gold borders.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero banner prominently displays Om symbol and Sanskrit greeting
Four category cards (Mantras, Aarti, Puja Vidhi, Bhajans) are visible
Daily Dharma Quote uses gold/saffron decorative styling
Shloka card has ornate gold-border card design
Overall layout feels like a sacred devotional portal

requirements.text: Redesign the AppLayout (frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx) header to feature a saffron-to-gold gradient background with the Om (ॐ) logo in gold, app name in Devanagari-style typography, and subtle mandala/floral decorative elements. Remove all dark styling from the header.
acceptanceCriteria: Header has saffron-to-gold gradient background
Om logo is rendered in gold color
App title uses devotional typography
No dark backgrounds or text remain in the header

requirements.text: Redesign the BottomNav (frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx) with a warm cream/saffron background, gold active state indicators, and saffron icon highlights. Active navigation items should glow with a soft golden halo effect.
acceptanceCriteria: BottomNav background uses warm cream or light saffron
Active nav item is highlighted with gold/saffron color
Icons use saffron coloring with gold active state
No dark theme styling remains

requirements.text: Redesign all page-level containers and card components (AartiCard, KathaCard, ShlokaCard, FestivalCountdownCard, DailyDharmaQuote) with warm devotional styling: gold/saffron borders, cream or warm gradient card backgrounds, ornate corner flourishes via CSS, and saffron-tinted section headers in Devanagari-inspired typography.
acceptanceCriteria: All card components use warm cream/gold backgrounds instead of dark
Cards have visible gold or saffron border accents
Section headers are styled with saffron/gold colors
Text in cards is dark (dark brown or maroon) for readability on light backgrounds

requirements.text: Redesign the Jap counter page (frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx) with a devotional sacred atmosphere: saffron/gold background gradient, the MalaRing rendered with gold/amber beads, mantra text displayed in large Sanskrit/Devanagari styling in saffron, and the count displayed in an ornate golden circle. The LotusBloomOverlay should use bright golden/saffron colors.
acceptanceCriteria: Jap page background uses saffron/gold warm gradient
MalaRing beads appear in gold/amber tones
Mantra text is large and styled in saffron Devanagari font
Count display is in an ornate golden circle design

requirements.text: Redesign the Aarti pages (frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx and frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx) with a devotional temple aesthetic: saffron hero banner with diya/flame imagery, gold-bordered aarti text cards, and warm amber/saffron background throughout. Aarti text should be displayed with high readability using dark maroon on cream background.
acceptanceCriteria: Aarti list page has saffron/gold hero banner
Individual aarti cards use warm cream with gold borders
Aarti detail page text is clearly readable (dark on light)
Overall feel matches a sacred temple environment

requirements.text: Update the global CSS (frontend/src/index.css and frontend/tailwind.config.js) to replace dark theme CSS custom properties with warm devotional light-theme values. Set the default color scheme to the saffron/gold palette. Ensure Tailwind devotional color tokens (saffron, gold, maroon, cream) are the primary palette used across the app. Remove dark mode class-based overrides that apply dark backgrounds.
acceptanceCriteria: CSS custom properties reflect warm devotional colors (no dark backgrounds as default)
Tailwind config devotional palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream) is fully utilized
Body/root background is cream or warm white, not dark
Font imports for Devanagari and Poppins remain intact

requirements.text: Redesign the Kathayen and KathaDetail pages (frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx, frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx) with warm saffron/gold styling. Tab filters should use saffron active states. Story cards should use cream backgrounds with gold borders. The detail page should present katha text with comfortable reading typography in dark maroon on cream.
acceptanceCriteria: Kathayen page tabs use saffron for active filter state
Katha cards use cream/gold styling
Detail page text is legible with proper contrast
No dark backgrounds on these pages

requirements.text: Redesign the Profile and Panchang pages (frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx, frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx) with the devotional saffron/gold theme. Panchang data cells should use warm amber/cream card styling with gold borders. Profile page should use saffron accents for mantra selection and stats display.
acceptanceCriteria: Panchang page uses warm amber/cream card styling
Profile page stats and mantra selector use saffron accents
Both pages are fully consistent with the overall devotional theme

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve all existing backend logic in backend/main.mo — no backend changes required
Preserve all existing functional features (Jap counter, Aarti display, Panchang calculations, AI Guru chat, Community posts)
Maintain Devanagari/Hindi font imports (Tiro Devanagari Hindi, Poppins)
nonGoals: Adding new content sections beyond what already exists
Changing backend data models or API endpoints
Adding new pages not already in the app
Adding English-only UI — Hindi/Sanskrit content should remain

required: Ornate saffron and gold mandala with Om symbol in center, suitable for app hero background (mandala-hero.dim_1200x400.png)
Decorative Hindu temple lotus flower in gold and saffron tones (lotus-decoration.dim_256x256.png)
Diya (oil lamp) flame illustration in warm golden tones (diya-icon.dim_128x128.png)
